protocol.historical_status: Leakage-safe historical test did not establish improvement. Exploratory future test only; no historical rows counted as forward evidence.
protocol.primary_metric: Paired log loss against the same-book market, equal fixture weighting; paper ROI is secondary

review.harm: Manual stop review if candidate-minus-Opponent log-loss interval is wholly positive at a decision milestone. No automatic promotion or retuning.
review.precision: Fixture-weighted paired Brier/log loss and independent-fixture paper ROI uncertainty; inconclusive while intervals include zero.

protocol.scope: Same first-scan Bet365 team-shots contracts and Opponent forecasts; complete exact-fixture 1X2 observed at/before both shots quotes and before kickoff, at most 3 hours old
protocol.selection: First registration batch per canonical fixture; retain no-bets and missing-input decisions; one best-EV selection per arm per fixture; preserve all non-edge blockers

strength_comparison.uncertainty: Descriptive 95% normal intervals across independent fixtures; small samples are inconclusive.
